row.title: MARKER-ROOT-1: conflict markers committed on main kept every PR in conflict until a session stepped in
row.body: PR 935 sat open with label conflict and Rowan had to call it out. Root cause: README.md and platform/adapters/README.md on main carried committed merge-conflict markers, so every PR conflicted there on each merge and scripts/resolve_generated.py could not match the nested hunks; with a conflict no hosted check ran on the new head either. Remedy in code: scripts/no_markers.py is a step in checks (a change that carries markers does not pass), scripts/regen_generated.py runs it with --fix after every merge to main (claim-only hunks are flattened with no person), and resolve_generated.py flatten() handles nested hunks. Tests ran: 425 Worker tests pass, flatten exercised on a nested sample.
